nodes.name: Gemini Short Reply
nodes.notes: FIX: Gemini REST API requires the key as query parameter ?key=VALUE, NOT as an HTTP header. API key is read from n8n env var via ={{ $env.GEMINI_API_KEY }}. No credential lookup. No hardcoded key. Pre-req: set GEMINI_API_KEY in your n8n environment before running.

meta.fixNote: v1 used httpHeaderAuth which caused 403 Forbidden. Gemini REST API requires ?key= query param, not a header. v2 uses authentication=none + sendQuery with $env.GEMINI_API_KEY expression.
